summary: Frontend-only testing of whole-show favorite feature in Cartoonix. Verified detail-fav-show button toggle behavior, toast, Profile 'Serial complet' display, and correct navigation (show-fav -> /show/<id>, episode-fav -> /watch/<id>/<n>). All acceptance criteria pass.

issues: Console warning: empty string ('') passed to img src attribute (likely a card image with missing poster). Non-blocking but should render null or hide element.

action_items: (Low) Fix empty-string `src` warning on img elements (render conditionally or pass null).
critical_code_review_comments: Using episode_number=0 as a sentinel for whole-show favorite is pragmatic but couples semantics into a magic value; consider a dedicated `type: 'show'|'episode'` field on favorites for long-term clarity.
Ensure isShowFavorite key composition ('${showId}:0') is consistently used everywhere favorites are checked to avoid drift.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Whole-show favorite via detail-fav-show works end-to-end. Login button label is 'Conectare' (not 'Autentificare'). Note: episode-fav heart click had no visible class change on the button itself (state indicated elsewhere/via icon color), but functionally toggles correctly - verified via Profile list.
